economic_mechanism: Stablecoins are the settlement rail of crypto trading. Primary-market issuance creates new dollar liabilities that are backed by fiat/T-bill purchases and are almost entirely deployed into crypto markets, so aggregate USD-pegged stablecoin supply growth measures net new dollars entering the crypto system. Because inflows are autocorrelated while liquidity is being deployed, a supply expansion above its own recent norm should be followed by positive net spot returns at the multi-day horizon, and a contraction should precede de-risking.

source_versions.SRC-049-001: DefiLlama API endpoint /stablecoincharts/all, retrieved and hashed in data/rfc049/vendor/VENDOR_MANIFEST.json

timeframe: 1d bars; decision evaluated weekly at Sunday 23:00:00 UTC; execution at the next daily bar open (Monday 00:00 UTC)
entry_rule: Let D_t be the total circulating value in USD of all USD-pegged stablecoins as published by the frozen vendor series (SRC-049-001), on the daily grid. Let r30_t = D_t / D_{t-30} - 1 (30-day net growth). Let B_t be the median of the previous 365 daily values of r30 ending at t-1 (strictly causal; B_t uses no value dated t or later). At each weekly decision instant, using the most recent daily observation t* whose availability time is <= Saturday 23:59:00 UTC, if r30_{t*} > B_{t*} the strategy is LONG; otherwise FLAT. A LONG state is opened at the next bar open after a transition from FLAT.
exit_rule: The position is closed at the next bar open after the weekly state becomes FLAT (r30 <= B). The runtime risk engine may close the position independently and unconditionally; the strategy has no discretionary stop, no target and no time stop beyond the state flip.
invalidation: Any acceptance threshold in acceptance_thresholds fails on the sealed out-of-sample window.
The locked-bootstrap lower confidence bound of net per-trip expectancy is <= 0 at the preregistered level.
The net edge does not survive the 1.5x cost stress.
The signal's incremental edge over the two declared baselines (buy-and-hold and the own-price 200-day trend state) is <= 0.
The vendor series is revised in a way that changes any decision already acted on (PIT integrity failure).
indicator_warmup: 395 daily values (30 for r30, 365 for the causal median) must exist before the first decidable day
position_sizing_policy: Long/cash spot, 1x notional, one position at a time, no leverage, no derivatives. The runtime risk engine owns sizing and limits and may reduce or veto; the strategy never sets margin or leverage.

risk_limits.per_trade_risk_budget: not set by the strategy; risk engine applies its certified limits unchanged
risk_limits.single_trade_concentration_limit: no single round trip may contribute more than 40% of positive net

holding_policy: State-based; minimum hold 1 day; no discretionary exit beyond the frozen rule
execution_model: Taker market orders on both legs at the next bar open after the decision instant; no maker fill assumption; no intrabar fills; costs from COST_MODEL_V3 (BINANCE_SPOT_STANDARD_TAKER) at the 200 USDT reference notional and at the measured notional of each simulation.

cost_model.knowledge: fees KNOWN (Binance Spot VIP0 published schedule); spread/slippage/impact ESTIMATED; no account-verified schedule
cost_model.note: the numeric values are recorded in data/rfc049/PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json, re-derived from the frozen model at build time, never typed by hand

market_data_version.price: data/raw/alpha001/BTC-USDT_1d.json (and ETH-USDT_1d.json for replication), sha256 recorded in PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json

development_period: first decidable day (on or after 2019-01-01) to 2023-12-31 (RESEARCH_EXPOSED: the daily price history and its general shape were inspected by RFC-035, RFC-046 and ALPHA-001/003; no result for this hypothesis or its sources was computed before this freeze)
validation_period: 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-10 (RESEARCH_EXPOSED, degraded evidential status: viewed by prior campaigns on other hypotheses; never used to fit this specification)
oos_policy: SEALED_FORWARD_OOS: observations collected strictly after the preregistration freeze timestamp recorded in PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json; opened exactly once, after either 20 closed round trips have accrued or 24 months have elapsed since the freeze, whichever comes first; if fewer than 20 closed round trips have accrued at 24 months the outcome is INSUFFICIENT_OOS_SAMPLE, never PASS and never REJECT on power alone.
statistical_tests: net per-trip expectancy = mean net PnL per closed round trip, after COST_MODEL_V3 costs
stationary block bootstrap (10,000 resamples, expected block length 7 days) one-sided 95% lower confidence bound on net expectancy
profit factor = gross positive net / gross negative net
1.5x cost stress: every modelled cost component multiplied by 1.5, all else unchanged
BH and Holm corrections across the campaign's admitted hypotheses for the primary p-value (block-bootstrap p)
sign stability across three equal consecutive sub-windows of each period

incremental tests: (a) versus buy-and-hold over identical active windows; (b) versus an own-price 200-day SMA long/cash state machine on the same asset; (c) versus the other admitted hypothesis's state (H-049-002)

acceptance_thresholds.minimum_oos_round_trips_or_months: 20 round trips or 24 months, whichever comes first

estimated_turnover.basis: pre-measurement estimate from the rule's design (weekly decisions, 30-day growth versus its 365-day median)
estimated_turnover.note: the drag is computed in PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json from the frozen cost model; realised turnover is measured in Phase B and may not be tuned

cost_feasibility: The rule trades a slow state with multi-week holding periods. The relevant hurdle per round trip is the frozen spot round-trip cost (see PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST.json). A move-cost ratio of at least 2x per trip is required and is checked in Phase B from measured turnover; if the measured turnover makes the cost drag exceed the measured gross edge, the outcome is COST_DISQUALIFIED.
expected_market_behavior: Signal positive in liquidity-expansion regimes (supply growing above its norm) with positive forward returns; flat or negative episodes during redemptions and depegs; expected strongest in trending/liquid regimes and weakest during forced-deleveraging episodes.
alternative_explanations: Endogeneity: stablecoin supply grows because prices rise (mint demand from existing holders), not because new dollars predict returns; the incremental test versus the 200-day trend baseline and versus buy-and-hold is designed to detect exactly this.
Trend proxy: the signal may be a slower expression of the same information as price momentum; if the trend baseline matches it, the hypothesis is rejected as a re-description.
Supply inflation from yield farming and cross-chain bridging without new demand.
Vendor revision: DefiLlama historical series may be backfilled; the one-day lag and the snapshot hashes are the mitigation.
counter_evidence: SRC-049-005 reports weak or non-systematic forward predictability from stablecoin events in a 2026 peer-reviewed study.

OPP-0003 (the project's registered USDT-exchange-flow opportunity) remains WATCH with the note that on-chain flow series are usually commercial and that the 1-2 hour horizon collides with the cost floor; this specification deliberately uses a free aggregate series and a cost-compatible horizon instead.
Issuance is partly endogenous to demand (minting accommodates buyers, not creates them).
data_requirements: daily aggregate USD-pegged stablecoin circulating supply (SRC-049-001), full history from 2017-11-28
daily spot OHLC for BTCUSDT (and ETHUSDT), in-repo klines from 2017-08
point_in_time_assumptions: the vendor's value dated day t is treated as available at 00:00:00 UTC of day t+1 (one full day of conservatism); no same-day use

the frozen research snapshot (VENDOR_MANIFEST.json sha256) is used for development and validation; live collection during the sealed period records the value at retrieval time, and the retrieved value is what the decision uses
a decision uses only values with availability_time <= decision_time - 1 hour margin; the Saturday 23:59 UTC cutoff enforces this
no future bar, no interpolated value, no forward-filled value beyond 3 consecutive missing days (a 4th missing day forces FLAT)
known_failure_modes: trend-proxy collapse (already measured elsewhere in this repository as the fate of several price-conditioned signals)
regime break: supply grows during price declines if redemptions lag
few round trips making the sample underpowered
cost drift above the modelled schedule
testable_predictions: net per-trip expectancy after costs is positive on development and validation data
the state's forward net return exceeds buy-and-hold and the 200-day trend baseline over the same windows
the sign is stable across three consecutive sub-windows of the development period
the frozen rule, re-run independently by a verifier that never imports the builder, reproduces every trade and metric
falsification_conditions: any acceptance threshold fails on the sealed OOS
the effect is indistinguishable from the trend baseline (incremental <= 0)
LONG-state forward net return <= FLAT-state forward net return after costs across development and validation
PIT audit finds any decision that consumed a value published after its decision instant
notes: Admission is not validation. No economic result for this hypothesis has been computed at freeze time.
